name: LEPTANDRA VIRGINICA
key_symptoms: Tongue coated yellow. Great distress in stomach and intestines, with desire for stool. Aching in region of liver extending to spine, which feels chilly.
Dull frontal pain; vertigo, drowsiness, and depression. Smarting and aching in eyes.
